the_two_runs_disagree.what_that_separates: Two different failures, not one. The arm G0 mismatches reproduce on both re-runs, so re-running model.generate today does not give the text the Addendum S/T comparator cell banked on 2026-09-03 -- a stable difference between then and now, not randomness. The arm C mismatch appeared once and not the second time, which is run-to-run instability in the constrained decoder itself on this checkpoint. Only this family is affected; the other four are 0 of 10 on both arms.
the_two_runs_disagree.why_both_runs_are_banked: The gate was run a second time only because the first failure had to be characterised, and the second run FAILS TOO. Re-running a gate until it passes would be the thing this page exists to prevent, so both runs are published and the reading withholds on either one.
